1:2.sourceText: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

groups.note: Actual dia with the accusative gives the causal on-account-of relation, rendered For ... sake as one English prepositional expression; no Greek sake noun is printed.
English makes truth possessive inside for truth’s sake; the source noun is accusative under dia, not genitive.
The actual unto-the-age duration expression is rendered for ever as a whole.
